chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Al-Harith ibn al-Mughira al-Nasri, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):
By what is the master of this command recognized? He said: By serenity, solemnity, knowledge, and the will (testament).

key_terms.وَالْوَصِيَّةِ: The testament, will, or designation of the successor

ai.seo_question: What are the four signs to recognize the Imam?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Rida (AS) identifies serenity, dignity, knowledge, and testament as the definitive markers of the Imam, emphasizing that spiritual authority is rooted in both inner tranquility and explicit designation. This framework underscores the Shia doctrine of *Nass* (designation), where the Imam’s legitimacy is confirmed not only by his profound scholarly depth but also by the clear chain of succession established by his predecessor.
